about.en: OG is the official fan token of OG, the esports organisation known for winning The International Dota 2 championship twice, issued on Chiliz's Socios.com platform. Holders can vote in team polls and access rewards and fan experiences. The token lives on Chiliz Chain at 0xb3f2e39acc68f98229b2587361a8ce30acdf0442, with issuer deployments on Base and Solana.
